ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Technology Entrepreneurship I. Prerequisite: Junior standing in engineering or science. The course covers a broad range of topics that critically affect technology based companies and technology based start-up businesses. Primary emphasis is placed on the marketing concerns, intellectual property issues, and business plan preparation for these technology based businesses. The students will apply this information by preparing a business plan for a high-tech company and through the examination of 12 case studies from the Harvard Business School collection.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing.
